metadata.question: Does Jabal Qidr have a darker color than Jabal Bayda, as observed in April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to find locations for "Jabal Qidr" and "Jabal Bayda" - these are mountains, likely in Middle East - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for visible imagery in April 2024 - "Darker color" typically means lower reflectance in visible bands (RGB) 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to see actual surface color - Use cloud masking for Sentinel-2 3. Logic: - Calculate mean reflectance across visible bands (RGB) for both locations - Compare: if Jabal Qidr has lower reflectance → darker → Answer A - Need to handle cases where data is missing or invalid - Valid zero reflectance would be extremely dark (unlikely but possible) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Jabal Qidr and Jabal Bayda are mountains in Saudi Arabia // Jabal Bayda (White Mountain) - approximately 24.4°N, 38.5°E const jabalBayda = ee.Geometry.Point([38.5, 24.4]); // Jabal Qidr - approximately 25.0°N, 37.8°E const jabalQidr = ee.Geometry.Point([37.8, 25.0]); const startDate = '2024-04-01'; const endDate = '2024-04-30'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get Sentinel-2 data for Jabal Qidr let colQidr = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(jabalQidr) .map(maskS2clouds); const sizeQidr = await colQidr.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jabal Qidr images found: ${sizeQidr}`); if (sizeQidr === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for Jabal Qidr, trying Landsat 8/9...'); colQidr = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(jabalQidr); const sizeQidrL = await colQidr.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jabal Qidr Landsat images: ${sizeQidrL}`); if (sizeQidrL === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get Sentinel-2 data for Jabal Bayda let colBayda = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(jabalBayda) .map(maskS2clouds); const sizeBayda = await colBayda.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jabal Bayda images found: ${sizeBayda}`); if (sizeBayda === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for Jabal Bayda, trying Landsat 8/9...'); colBayda = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(jabalBayda); const sizeBaydaL = await colBayda.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jabal Bayda Landsat images: ${sizeBaydaL}`); if (sizeBaydaL === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Create median composites and select RGB bands const imgQidr = colQidr.median().select(['B4', 'B3', 'B2']); const imgBayda = colBayda.median().select(['B4', 'B3', 'B2']); // Calculate mean reflectance (average of RGB) for Jabal Qidr const statsQidr = await imgQidr.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: jabalQidr.buffer(1000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const countQidr = statsQidr['B4_count'] || 0; console.log(`Jabal Qidr valid pixels: ${countQidr}`); if (countQidr === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const meanQidr = (statsQidr['B4_mean'] + statsQidr['B3_mean'] + statsQidr['B2_mean']) / 3; // Calculate mean reflectance for Jabal Bayda const statsBayda = await imgBayda.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: jabalBayda.buffer(1000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const countBayda = statsBayda['B4_count'] || 0; console.log(`Jabal Bayda valid pixels: ${countBayda}`); if (countBayda === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const meanBayda = (statsBayda['B4_mean'] + statsBayda['B3_mean'] + statsBayda['B2_mean']) / 3; // Validate results if (meanQidr === null || meanBayda === null || isNaN(meanQidr) || isNaN(meanBayda)) { console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Jabal Qidr mean reflectance: ${meanQidr.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Jabal Bayda mean reflectance: ${meanBayda.toFixed(2)}`); // Darker color means lower reflectance if (meanQidr < meanBayda) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
